description: Create a new calendar event. Supports setting title, time, attendees, description, location, and Google Meet links.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

add_meet.description: Attach a Google Meet video conference link to the event (default: false)

location.description: Event location (physical address or room name)

send_updates.description: Who to send invite notifications to (default: "all")

name: gws-mcp__calendar_create_event
